case.question: what is average mileage on a car
case.expected_answer: About 12,000 miles per year, according to the supplied comment.
case.support_quote: The average annual milage on a car should be 12,000 miles per year,so for example: if the car is 4 years old then the milage should be around 48,000 miles.
case.source_qualification: An informal annual-distance estimate from a user comment, not a verified population statistic, lifetime mileage or fuel economy.
